title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): vector search and citations

videos.script: A model does not know the shop's rules. Thirty days for a return, fifteen for shipping, what error E1042 means. {{rules}} Retrieval puts those rules into the request, at the moment of the question. In this lesson you build it in a few lines. Cut a handbook into passages, turn each into a vector, and search them. {{index}} Then you watch search by meaning miss an error code that search by words finds at once, and you combine the two. {{hybrid}} The passages go into the prompt with ids, and the answer has to cite them. {{prompt}} Then a program checks the citations. It catches a sentence that cites nothing, and it lets through a wrong answer that cites nothing on purpose. {{check}} Last, you measure the search itself, on twelve questions, and find that the combination is not a free win. {{measure}}
